out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Thermometers Calibrated per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The ambient air temperature gauge on one of the milk rerfrigerators was not in good repair and/ or not accurate in the range of use.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air temperature devices shall be maintained in good repair and be accurate within the intended range of use. The PIC has already submit a work order to get the thermometer repaired. If not repaired soon, please install second thermometer inside the unit so that you can monitor it’s holding temperature.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the front door on the Beverage Air milk refrigerator on the left side of the serving fell off during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Please have the door repaired as soon as possible. Not doing so could lead to an injury.
